description.zh:
指定返回迁移任务历史的数量。  
取值：大于0小于等于1000  
默认值：1000
description.en:
The maximum number of history entries to return.
Valid values: 1 to 1000.
Default value: 1000.
The name of the migration task whose run history to retrieve.

description.zh:
设定从该marker之后列举任务运行历史。  
默认值：无
description.en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the marker value returned in the previous response to retrieve the next page of results. If not specified, results are returned from the beginning.

description.zh: 任务执行ID。指定执行ID，只会list该执行ID的运行历史。
description.en: The execution ID of a specific run. Specify this parameter to retrieve the run history for only that execution.

descriptions.zh:
- 列举任务运行历史，您必须有mgw:ListImportJobHistory权限。
- 迁移任务可以运行多轮，每轮运行有一个唯一的执行ID。
- 迁移任务运行历史记录了任务的状态变更历史。
descriptions.en:
- Call this operation to retrieve the run history of a specified migration task. A migration task can have multiple runs, each identified by a unique execution ID. The run history records status changes that occur during each execution.

- Required permission: mgw:ListImportJobHistory
